title: Modified One-Axis-Twist Squeezing for Deterministic Orientation Control of Schrödinger Cat States with Unknown Atom-Number Parity
summary: The Schrödinger cat state protocol (SCSP) makes use of a Schrödinger cat (SC) state generated with one-axis-twist squeezing (OATS) to enhance the sensitivity. In principle, the SCSP can magnify the phase shift by a factor N, the number of atoms under interrogation, accompanied by a quantum noise amplification by a factor of root-N, enabling an atomic sensor to reach the Heisenberg limit. However, the current SCSP can reach this benchmark only if the parity of N is known, which is almost impossible for a large ensemble.
